messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary deployment r1234 -> release-v123 returned elevated 500s in eu-west-1 (canary-3). Rolling errors spike 03:24 UTC. Suspected: image tag mismatch (push used 'latest' instead of 'release-v123').

maria: paging ben and carla. i’m oncall, jumping in. can someone confirm if release pipeline pushed the wrong tag?

ben: looking now — i see the CI job for release-v123 completed, but registry shows image: 'service-backend:latest' with digest that matches a non-release build. suspicious. tagging step may have reused cache.

carla: on it. i'm isolating canary, will flip traffic split to 0% for canary-3. can we enable kill-switch for the new feature flag as immediate mitigation?

maria: yes turn feature flag off for prod. path: console.redwood.internal/fflags -> chat_gen_new_routing -> off. who can toggle?

ben: i can. toggling now.

ben: toggled chat_gen_new_routing -> off. posting screenshot for audit: <https://ci.internal/snap/ab12>. reaction :thumbsup:

carla: traffic to canary-3 set to 0%. running healthchecks.

maria: customers: initial telemetry shows ~0.6% of requests to /v1/chat failing with 500s between 03:24-03:36 UTC. rate-limited to canary cohort ~0.7% of overall traffic. likely limited impact but still user-facing. tagging CS to notify high-touch accounts.

tim: noted. will draft message for major customers with verbose error note and ETA.

registry-bot: CI registry scan: tag anomaly detected for image service-backend:latest. digest mismatch: expected sha256:abcd...1234 for release-v123; observed sha256:dead...beef. Possible caching/cache-poisoning in tag step.

ben: here's the release pipeline snippet that runs during tag step:
```
# build
docker build -t $REGISTRY/service-backend:$COMMIT .
# tag
docker tag $REGISTRY/service-backend:$COMMIT $REGISTRY/service-backend:release-v123 || true
# push
docker push $REGISTRY/service-backend:release-v123
```
notice the `|| true` — that will hide failures in tag step. hmm.

carla: that'll explain silent failures. if tag failed but push of 'latest' succeeded earlier, registry ends up with latest pointing to wrong digest but release tag missing or pointing differently.

maria: urgent mitigation list: 1) rollback canary to previous image 2) disable feature flag (done) 3) fix pipeline tagging and re-run promotion 4) notify customers 5) postmortem. who owns rollback?

ben: i'll trigger a rollback job to pin canary to release-v122 (previous stable). running pipeline job: `jobs/rollback-canary`

deploy-bot: Job started: jobs/rollback-canary (#457) by ben at 03:28 UTC.

ben: rollback applied to canary-3. kubectl rollout status deployment/service-backend -n eu-west-1-canary:
```
deployment "service-backend" successfully rolled out
```
carla: verifying metrics — error rate dropped back to baseline within 15s of rollback. good.

maria: performing oncall handoff to carla in 20 minutes, will stick around until customers notified.

ben: updating CI: removing `|| true` and adding explicit fail on tag. also adding digest verification step:
```
docker push $REGISTRY/service-backend:release-v123
# verify
remote_digest=$(docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' $REGISTRY/service-backend:release-v123)
if [ "$remote_digest" != "$expected" ]; then
  echo "digest mismatch"; exit 1
fi
```
re-running promotion now.

registry-bot: Promotion run succeeded. release-v123 now points to expected digest sha256:abcd...1234.

jack: product note — feature was on for 3% of traffic in canary ring? we saw 0.7% impacted because of routing; keeping kill-switch until patch confirmed.

tim: customer messaging drafted and sent to enterprise customers affected; public status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-15-rolling.

maria: taking timeline notes for postmortem. quick summary: root cause = tagging step masked failure (`|| true`) leading to recycled 'latest' tag being pushed; pipeline cache behavior allowed stale image to be promoted -> mis-tagged release. mitigations = feature flag off, canary rollback, pipeline fix, added digest verification, added alert on tag/push mismatch. next steps: blameless postmortem, CI change applied in repo: infra/ci/docker-promote, rotate/notify registry team.

carla: i'll take incident ownership for follow-up. assigning action items in tickets: INFRA-1123 (remove || true), INFRA-1124 (digest verification), SRE-809 (add tag-push monitors), PM-456 (customer follow-up).

ben: note for release engineers: avoid using mutable tags like `latest` in promotion; use digest pinning and immutable release tags.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Services stabilized at 03:34 UTC. cause: CI tag step masking + registry cache led to wrong image tag in canary. severity: SEV3 (customer-facing but limited scope). escalation closed.

maria: thanks all. carla, pick this up for postmortem. will join. closing thread in 1 hour unless objections. :white_check_mark:
